# Capsule figure assets

Textured, skinned Pokémon models: https://github.com/pokemon-party/3d-pokemon/tree/main/models/opt/regular

Downloaded regular-form GLBs for 1, 4, 6, 7, 9, 25, 133, 681. Model 681 is stored as 10026.glb to match the shared catalog's Aegislash Blade form ID. Its source is the standard Aegislash mesh with a shield; the renderer offsets and opens the guard for a battle stance. It is not a separately sourced, exact Blade-form asset.

Geometry compression was decoded locally; textures, skinning and animation clips were retained. Bulbasaur has authored idle/walk clips. Other figures use procedural animation of original skeleton joints, plus whole-body breathing, movement hops, attack lunges and hit recoil. Source license is retained at models/SOURCE-LICENSE.txt. The source repository's MIT license does not transfer ownership of Pokémon characters or their original artwork.

Offline fallback portraits: https://github.com/PokeAPI/sprites/tree/master/sprites/pokemon/other/home (same eight catalog form IDs).

Pokémon characters and artwork belong to their respective owners. These are unofficial fan-project assets. No assets were extracted from the Capsule Monster Coliseum disc, and no files in sibling games were modified.
